lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎩᎶ ᎾᏱᏍᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᏰᎵ ᎠᏴ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
lines.text: Gi-lo na-yi-s-gv-na i-ge-se-s-di u-tse-li tsu-da-hna-wa-dv a-le na-gi-s-da-wa-de-gv-na i-ge-se-s-di, v-tla ye-li a-yv a-qua-tse-li i-gv-wa-li-s-do-di yi-ge-se-s-di.
lines.english: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
lines.emitted_text: khilo nayihskvna ikelhehsti utseli i tsutanhawita v ale nakhstakwatekvna ikewhsehsti vlha yeli ayv akwatseli ikvwalhstohti yikehsehsti

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᎬᏅ ᎢᎠᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎢᎤᏲᎱᏎᎮᏍᏗ ᎬᏅ ᎠᏴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
lines.text: Gi-lo-no gv-nv i-a-wa-ti-s-ge-s-di, na-s-gi u-yo-hu-se-di ge-se-s-di; gi-lo-no i-u-yo-hu-se-he-s-di gv-nv a-yv nv-di-ga-li-s-do-di-s-ge-s-di, na-s-gi u-wa-dv-di ge-se-s-di.
lines.english: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
lines.emitted_text: khilonho kvnhv iyawhahthihskehsti nvhski uyohuhsehti kehsehsti iyano'i uyohulhehehsti kvnhv v ayv natikalhstohtihskehsti a vhski uwhahthvhti ikehsehsti

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᎠᏴ ᏓᏆᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᏅᏛᎩᏅᏒᎯ
lines.text: Gi-lo-no de-tsa-da-ni-lv-ge-s-di, na-s-gi a-yv da-qua-da-ni-lv-ge-s-di; gi-lo-no a-yv da-qua-da-ni-lv-ge-s-di, na-s-gi da-da-ni-lv-ge-s-di nv-dv-gi-nv-sv-hi
lines.english: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
lines.emitted_text: khilonho tetsatanilvkehsti nvhski aya takwatanilvkehsti khilonho'ayv takwatanilvkehsti nvhski tatanilvkehsti yitvkinvhsvhi

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶᏃ ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙ ᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
lines.text: Gi-lo-no da-da-ni-lv-ge-s-di a-do-le-ho-s-gi a-do-le-ho-s-gi ge-sv u-di-ga-li-s-do-di-ge-s-di, a-do-le-ho-s-gi a-ga-gu-yv-da-ne-di ge-sv na-s-gi a-ga-gu-yv-da-ne-he-s-di; gi-lo-no da-da-ni-lv-ge-s-di u-da-nv-ti a-s-ga-ya u-da-nv-ti ge-sv u-di-ga-li-s-do di-s-ge-s-di, u-da-nv-ti a-s-ga-ya a-ga-gu-yv-da-ne-di ge-sv na-s-gi a-ga-gu-yv-da-ne-he-s-di.
lines.english: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
lines.emitted_text: khilonho tatanilvkehsti atolehohski' utolewhohskikelhv nitikalhstohtihskehsti atolehohski akkvyv'i htikehsv a nvhski akakuyvehehsti khilonho tatsanilvkehsti utanhthi ahskaya utanhti kelhv nikalhstohtihskehsti utanhthi ahskaya akvkuyv'i htikelhv v nvhski akakuyv ehehsti

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎩᎶᏃ ᏌᏉ ᎯᎠ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗᏉ ᎠᎧᎵᎢ ᎤᏴᏜᏓᎠᎹ ᎠᎱᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
lines.text: Gi-lo-no sa-quo hi-a tsu-na-s-di ge-sv-i u-li-s-qui-di-quo a-ka-li-i u-yv-dla a-ma a-hu-v-s-ge-s-di a-gi-s-da-wa-di-do-hi ge-sv nv-di-ga-li-s-do-di-s-ge-s-di, u-do-hi-yu-hi-ya ni-tsv-we-se-ha, v-tla na-s-gi u-yo-hu-se-di yi-ge-se-s-di a-ga-gu-yv-e-di ge-sv-i.
lines.english: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
lines.emitted_text: khilonho sakwu hi'a tsunhstikelhv v ulihskwitikwu akhali'i uyhvtla ama hwu'vhskehsti vkhstawatitohi ikelhv nitikalhstohtihskehsti utohiyuhiya nitsvwehseha i i v lha nahski uyohuhsehti yikehsehsti i akvkuyv'ehti ikehshv'i
